collection_license: Mixed source-specific licences; no uniform MIT claim
purpose: Reviewable expansion only; no app/data edits, no API calls that incur inference charges, no push/workflows.

excluded_sources: unlicensed scraped provider tables as replacement data
policy.prices: Only reviewed explicit licensed catalogue cells or explicitly licensed first-party tables, plus exact unit conversions. Provider pages corroborate licensed records; no licence transfer is assumed.
policy.context: Use explicit max_input_tokens or limit.context only. Never legacy max_tokens, never audio-second/image token limits as LLM context. Preserve provider scope.
policy.unit_safety: No tokens-to-characters conversions. Per-image prices include settings and component scope. Token-billed native rates are separate. Rounded provider/catalogue rates identified.
